def choose_move(observation):
    sx, sy = observation.get("self_position", [0, 0])
    ox, oy = observation.get("opponent_position", [0, 0])
    grid_width = observation.get("grid_width", 1)
    grid_height = observation.get("grid_height", 1)
    env = observation.get("environment_name", "resource_collection")
    # Defensive access
    self_role = observation.get("self_role", "")
    unclaimed = observation.get("unclaimed_cells") or []
    opponent_territory = observation.get("opponent_territory") or []
    resources = observation.get("resources") or []

    # Pursuit/Evasion
    if env == "pursuit_evasion":
        if self_role == "pursuer":
            dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
            dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
            return [dx, dy]
        # Evade: move away from opponent
        dx = 1 if ox == sx else (-1 if ox > sx else 1)
        dy = 1 if oy == sy else (-1 if oy > sy else 1)
        return [dx, dy]
    
    # Territory control
    if env == "territory_control":
        targets = unclaimed if unclaimed else opponent_territory
        if not targets:
            return [0, 0]
        target = min(targets, key=lambda t: abs(t[0]-sx)+abs(t[1]-sy))
        dx = 0 if target[0] == sx else (1 if target[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if target[1] == sy else (1 if target[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    
    # Resource collection
    if resources:
        best = min(resources, key=lambda r: abs(r[0]-sx)+abs(r[1]-sy))
        dx = 0 if best[0] == sx else (1 if best[0] > sx else -1)
        dy = 0 if best[1] == sy else (1 if best[1] > sy else -1)
        return [dx, dy]
    # No resources, default to move towards opponent
    dx = 0 if ox == sx else (1 if ox > sx else -1)
    dy = 0 if oy == sy else (1 if oy > sy else -1)
    return [dx, dy]
